answer: Each identity locks a walnut stake and must keep one live compute chamber deep in a karst of distinct AS paths. A public chamber table lists each chamber's heartbeat hash; an auditor recomputes them against a rotating anchor beacon. Shared GPU fingerprints, missing heartbeats, or two keys on one chamber burn the stake. First chamber costs 45 credits; the kth costs 45+9(k-1), so 1000 fakes cost ~4.5M plus locked walnut stakes. Honest agents pay once and recover the bond after audit.
